leading_positions.synthesis: All six round-1 configurations are a single-part B021 prize with the same three laureates (Drucker, Holst, Mojsov) and Knudsen not included. The citation wordings differ only slightly: all name GLP-1 physiology and its active form and the resulting incretin-based treatment of diabetes and obesity, and some members add type 2 specifically. What is shared is the merit and maturity case (incretin physiology, proglucagon processing, the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide, receptor biology, independently replicated, outcome-trial evidence). What is not settled is whether the attribution can be defended; each member states it as the main weakness, and several say they would reconsider the configuration if it cannot.

areas_of_agreement: All six members explicitly prefer a single-achievement B021 prize to Drucker, Holst and Mojsov, and each says the case rests on the science and not on the unanimity of the opening ranks.
Members describe B021 as mature: the mechanism has been independently confirmed for about three decades, and the drugs have glycaemic, weight, cardiovascular and renal outcome evidence.
All six name attribution as the weakest point of B021: Mojsov's share is contested, Habener is not on the credit list, and Knudsen's industrial development of long-acting analogues is left out.

B022 (unfolded protein response) appears as a first or second alternative for five members (el-manira-abdel, linnarsson-sten, perlmann-thomas, sandberg-rickard, wahren-herlenius-marie) and as a second alternative for svenningsson-per, so it is the most commonly named fallback. Alternatives are not preferred configurations and are not counted as votes.
Every member states that the historical credit claims rest on recollection and have not been checked against primary sources.
scientific_disputes: Whether B021 should be credited as physiology (the incretin effect, peptide identification, receptor biology) or whether the therapeutic breakthrough lies mainly in analogue development; members differ in how much weight development should carry.

Whether B022 would rank above B012, B052, B045 or B007 as the secondary option, which depends on how much direct clinical consequence a prize should show against mechanistic originality. Wahren-Herlenius questions whether B001 (cGAS-STING, therapeutic translation still early) or B022 (cleaner attribution, less direct clinical impact) should be the lead alternative.
Whether enabling technologies such as B016 (optogenetics) have enough direct medical impact, given the unresolved split between channelrhodopsin discovery and neuronal deployment.
Whether B007 (antisense splicing correction in SMA) shows durable benefit and separable mechanism and chemistry contributions, or whether the evidence is too recent.
attribution_disputes: B021: Mojsov's share of the active-peptide identification versus the priority claim of Habener, who is not among the credited names; the supplied record cannot resolve this and members said they would not adjudicate from recollection.

B021: whether Knudsen (liraglutide and semaglutide) should be included, replace Mojsov or Drucker, or be left out on a discovery-versus-development basis; the three-person limit forces an exclusion in every configuration.
B021 fallback: svenningsson-per and sandberg-rickard raise a narrower two-person configuration (Holst and Drucker; or B022) if the Mojsov/Habener question cannot be answered.
B052 (CAR-T): early chimeric receptor credit, including Eshhar, lies outside the supplied credited names (Sandberg, Svenningsson, El-Manira).
B045 (imatinib): foundational BCR-ABL genetics and early compound work lie outside the supplied credited names, so the citation would be harder to word.
B001 (cGAS-STING): the five credited names (Chen, Barber, Ishikawa, Sun, Wu) would need a careful split, as raised by El-Manira.
B016 (optogenetics): six credited names do not fit three seats, and Miesenbock's earlier work complicates the picture.
maturity_disputes: B021 is treated as mature by all six members; no member argues it is premature.
B001 (cGAS-STING): mechanism clear but therapeutic translation not yet established, so some members rank it below mature options (El-Manira's reply to Wahren-Herlenius).
B007 (SMA antisense): long-term durability is still accumulating and newer SMA modalities complicate what a prize would single out.
B052 (CAR-T): toxicity and relapse limit how settled the clinical picture is, against durable remissions in refractory B-cell malignancies.
B012 (TNF blockade) is described as fully mature and arguably overdue, but it is a first or second alternative only for el-manira-abdel and is not in any member's preferred configuration.
conflict_or_recusal_flags: No member reports a specific conflict with any shortlisted ballot; no recusal is indicated by any of the six files.

Disclosed relationships that do not involve shortlisted candidates: co-authorship between Perlmann and Svenningsson and between Perlmann and El-Manira; Linnarsson and Sandberg co-authorship; the chair's postdoctoral work with Paul Greengard. Several members note shared Karolinska Institutet affiliation, which alone is not treated as a conflict.

Wahren-Herlenius flags subject-area closeness (autoimmunity, rheumatology, type I interferon) to B012 and B001, describing it as topical overlap and not a personal tie, and would still flag B012 to the committee.
questions_for_round2: Can the committee sustain Mojsov's credit for identification of the active GLP-1 peptide against Habener's claim on the documented record, and if not, is the right configuration Holst and Drucker only, with Mojsov and Habener decided on evidence, or no award this year?

If B021 is awarded, does the committee accept leaving out Knudsen on a discovery-versus-development basis, or would it prefer a trio that includes drug development, and which credited basic discoverer would then be displaced?
Should the citation cover physiology and the identification of the active peptide only, or mention treatment? Would mentioning treatment imply credit to the drug developers who are not laureates?

Is a two-part prize (B021 with B022) feasible under the three-person limit, given that the credited sets total five names (B022 has Mori and Walter, B021 has Drucker, Holst, Knudsen, Mojsov), or is single-achievement B021 the committee's choice?

Which alternative should serve as fallback if B021 attribution cannot be settled, B022 (cleaner attribution, less clinical reach), B001, B012, B052, B045 or B007, and what attribution or maturity evidence would settle that choice?

Can members verify the contested credit histories (GLP-1 peptide identification, CAR-T chimeric receptor origins, imatinib and BCR-ABL genetics) against the supplied record instead of recollection before round 2 positions are fixed?
summary.chair_observation: Round 1 shows complete agreement on the preferred configuration (B021 to Drucker, Holst and Mojsov) and equally complete agreement that its attribution is the open weakness. Members differ mostly on fallbacks, where B022 is named most often and B012, B052, B045, B007 and B001 each have one or two backers. Round 2 should focus on the Mojsov/Habener priority question, the Knudsen exclusion, and what fallback applies if the attribution cannot be settled, and should not read the consensus on rank as a settled attribution.
